name: OFFWORLD
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A drone synth: colossal 80s brass, endless reverb, rain on neon
description: A drone synth in the spirit of 80s sci-fi film scores. Two detuned saws per voice, a brass filter envelope, ensemble chorus, a reverb up to 30 s with FREEZE, synthesized rain and thunder. Four macro knobs on sweetspots (SWELL, DRIFT, SPACE, RAIN), DRONE with a deep root, EPIC, a low split the melody follows in 8 scales, GLIDE, key pressure, CUES that slide into each other, MEMORY. On the screen: eight night-city scenes, a story of one night, lights that follow your notes.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
